Third-party model sources are restored from the repositories and commits in dependencies.json.
YOLOv12: https://github.com/sunsmarterjie/yolov12
YOLOv5: https://github.com/ultralytics/yolov5
YOLACT: https://github.com/dbolya/yolact
RF-DETR: https://github.com/roboflow/rf-detr
Torchvision: https://github.com/pytorch/vision

Original copyright notices and license terms remain applicable to restored sources and patches.
Project-specific adaptations are distributed as diffs, not as a claim of original authorship of the model frameworks.
